text:
maria: Heads-up — Dedicated pool e-12 rolled driver 12.8.3 last night; seeing small-batch P99 jump ~2.5x on gpt-medium workloads. Blocking the canary rollout.
kevin: Can you paste the perf dashboard / traces?
maria: Dashboard -> https://perf.redwood/internal/d/abc123/smallbatch?orgId=1 : shows spikes aligned with matmul_dispatch and kv_prefetch. Kernel selection flipped to matmul_v2_64x64 for M<=32 sequences which used to pick matmul_v1_32x128.
sam: :eyes: Which change actually triggered the bump (driver vs triton vs infra)?
maria: infra/ops merged infra/ops#2045 yesterday (driver 12.8.3 + triton 2.8.5). Rollout started 02:00 UTC -> canary -> dedicated.
kevin: CI flagged anything? perf-bot?
perf-bot: Alert: nightly-smallbatch job runtime/ci/smallbatch shows P99 increased 1.9x vs baseline. See https://ci.redwood/alerts/PLF-2290
jen: I pulled a quick trace on a canary host. Kernel timings look like:
```
matmul_v1_32x128  0.85ms
matmul_v2_64x64   1.72ms
kv_prefetch_async 0.12ms -> 0.45ms (queue wait increased)
```
kevin: That smells like a kernel selection flip. cuBLAS/triton heuristics plus driver changes can change preferred kernel. Also seeing increased L2 traffic -> more KV cache evictions. Can we bisect between the triton/autotune table bump and the driver bump?
maria: Starting a bisect on canary images now. Steps I'm running: 
```
# on ci image
git checkout main
git bisect start --bad HEAD --good 2023-11-15
git bisect run ./tools/bench_smallbatch.sh
```
sam: My hunch is triton autotune table refresh (triton#987) changed available kernels / perf ranks.
maria: Bisect landed on commit 9f3a2b8 (triton: update autotune table). Reverting that commit on a canary host restores old kernel selection and brings P99 back to baseline.
kevin: Interesting — so driver exposed a different performance envelope, but the immediate trigger was the autotune table update selecting a different kernel.
jen: Short-term mitigation: patch runtime autotune selector to prefer matmul_v1 for sequence lengths <=40 (sequence-length penalty). I have a draft PR runtime#4321.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused: infra/ops#2045 (driver 12.8.3) - canary -> dedicated blocked due to latency SLO breach.
maria: Plan: 1) revert triton autotune table (revert PR incoming), 2) merge runtime#4321 to add seq-length penalty so autotune won't pick 64x64 for small M, 3) re-run canary and e2e perf checks, 4) if green, resume driver rollout with staged ramp and tighter canary thresholds.
kevin: SGTM. Add an e2e profiling test in CI that compares kernel choices + P99 across driver versions to detect this earlier.
perf-bot: Created PERF ticket PERF-1129 linking runtime#4321 and triton#987.
sam: I'll own the revert PR and coordinate with infra to freeze the driver rollout until we validate.
maria: Thanks all — tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:
